title: Cauliflower Ouzi
description: A warm and flavorful eastern dish made with roasted cauliflower and a blend of spices.
instructions: Rinse the cauliflower and break it into florets.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the cauliflower to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Spread the cauliflower on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Remove the cauliflower from the oven and let it cool slightly.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and warm spices (if using).
Drizzle the lemon juice mixture over the cauliflower and toss to coat.
Serve the cauliflower hot, garnished with additional warm spices if desired.
